production_notes: Structure: glass, mirror, clean puddle, broken puddle; simple cuts and one consistent grade.
Preserve a clean silent master; add discovery music natively on each platform.

Curated Pexels material must not be described as personally filmed or photographed.
Human visual and audio approval is required before scheduling.
